posts.title: Armageddon Time
posts.description: Written and directed by James Gray, Armageddon Time is the story of a Jewish-American boy who befriends an African-American boy in the early 1980s in New York City during a tumultuous time in the city’s history as well as the expectations from his own family. posts.title: Marc by Sofia
posts.description: Directed by Sofia Coppola, Marc by Sofia is a documentary film about the life and work of fashion designer Marc Jacobs. The film is Coppola’s first non-fiction feature film where she explores Jacobs’ work and his upbringing as well as their friendship as he is preparing for a major show.
